parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRouteTableId
parameters.description: The route table ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
Specifies whether a next query token (Token) exists. Valid values:
- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if no next query exists.
- If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The route match mode.
- **prefix-exact-match**: exact match.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The list of destination CIDR blocks.

parameters.name: ServiceType
parameters.description: The type of route hosting. If this field is empty, the route is not hosted. Valid values: TR, which indicates that the hosting type is transit router.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance connection.
